headline: Malaysia Marine Department warns mariners around PM3 CAA drilling activity
location: Block PM3 CAA, South China Sea (06°58.638′N, 104°10.825′E)
assetName: HAKURYU-14 drilling rig and support vessels JM ABADI and PTSC TITAN
facts: Notice to Mariners 176(T)/2026 states that vessel movements and exploration-well drilling at Block PM3 CAA run from 22 September through 16 October 2026.
The notice identifies one drilling rig and two anchor-handling tug supply vessels and gives a WGS-84 work-area coordinate.
Source tier: Tier 1 primary maritime regulator; the fetched PDF text directly verifies the issue date, activity period, vessels, coordinate and navigation instruction.
excerpt: Mariners are advised to give wide berth when passing and navigate with caution when in the vicinity.
materialityReason: A regulator-directed wide berth and caution around named offshore assets creates a defined maritime-access constraint for vessels transiting the work area.
missingInfo: The notice does not quantify the berth distance, traffic delays, affected voyages or any port-call impact.
No operator confirmation of actual activity commencement on 22 September was located.

headline: Hong Kong Marine Department schedules six-hour outage of all electronic port-formality services
facts: The Marine Department eBS page states that all eBS services will be unavailable from 18:00 to 23:59 HKT on 22 September 2026.
The same primary page describes eBS as handling port formalities and shipping-related documents required by the Marine, Health and Immigration departments.
Source tier: Tier 1 primary maritime regulator; the live page directly verifies the outage date, hours and affected service scope.
excerpt: eBS maintenance will be carried out on 22 September 2026 (Tuesday); all services are listed as temporarily unavailable from 18:00 to 23:59 HKT.
materialityReason: Temporary loss of the regulator's full electronic service channel can affect timely submission or processing of port formalities and shipping documents during the stated window.
missingInfo: The page does not display a publication timestamp, so publication within the 9-22 September window cannot be proven.
No fallback submission method, affected transaction count or evidence of realized processing delay is stated.
